title: Dispatch fixes and a simpler RPM CyberCom setup
changes: Fixed: the AI dispatcher sometimes stayed silent after a server got Premium, a trial or RPM CyberCom, until the bot restarted. It now starts listening straight away

Dispatch no longer ignores people without the officer role. When they say "dispatch", it tells them only officers can talk to dispatch. Saying "dispatch" in a civilian channel tells you to start with "RPM" there instead
RPM CyberCom in /setup now shows why dispatch might not answer: no police radio channels, no dispatch channel, the bot missing voice permissions, or you not having the officer role
Police radio channels in RPM CyberCom are the same channels as the patrol channels in AI Voice Dispatch. Set them once, in either place, and they show in both
Traffic stop channels are now set only in /setup under RPM CyberCom. They are no longer in the AI Voice Dispatch setup or on the dashboard
